groups.sourceText: the well-known / the best-known / good (well) → better → best

items.exampleZh: 那个著名的故事是真的。

items.example: This is the best-known computer here.
items.exampleZh: 这是这里最著名的电脑。

items.example: Amy did the best in the quiz.
items.exampleZh: 艾米在小测验中表现最好。

items.example: The keyboard is beside the screen.

items.exampleZh: 她不用这台笔记本电脑。

groups.sourceText: as ... as ... / as + adj. / adv. + as ... / not as + adj. / adv. + as ... / This laptop is as light as that one. / This old computer is not as fast as the new one.

items.example: This laptop is as light as that one.
items.exampleZh: 这台笔记本电脑和那台一样轻。

items.example: This old computer is not as fast as the new one.
items.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑不如新电脑快。

items.example: The mouse is beside the keyboard.

items.exampleZh: 除了英语，我还学习语文。

items.example: The old computer weighed many tons.

groups.sourceText: as big as an elephant / as heavy as four elephants

items.example: The machine is as big as an elephant.
items.exampleZh: 这台机器和一头大象一样大。

items.example: It is as heavy as four elephants.
The computer can do maths tasks.
items.exampleZh: 电脑可以完成数学任务。
它可以完成困难的任务。

items.meaningZh: 制作了；使得了（make 的过去式）
items.exampleZh: 爸爸做了一个小机器人。

items.example: The chip is as small as a grain of salt.
items.exampleZh: 这块芯片和一粒盐一样小。

items.example: How amazing! The tiny chip can do so much.
items.exampleZh: 太神奇了！这块小芯片能做这么多事。

items.example: I got an email from Amy.
items.exampleZh: 我收到了一封艾米发来的电子邮件。

items.example: Please write an email to me.
items.exampleZh: 请给我写一封电子邮件。

items.example: We use computers to send emails.
items.exampleZh: 我们用电脑发送电子邮件。

items.example: I got the book as a gift.
items.exampleZh: 我收到这本书作为礼物。

items.example: Turn off the light before bed.
Do not mess up the files.
I need to finish my homework.

groups.sourceText: power on / shut down / power off

items.example: Power off the screen after use.

items.exampleZh: 我的密码里有一个数字。

items.example: Add a symbol to the password.
Do not tell others my password.
items.exampleZh: 不要把我的密码告诉别人。

items.example: I am lucky to have your help.

groups.sourceText: care / take care of / careful / carefully / careless / carelessly

items.example: I take care of my little brother.

items.exampleZh: 使用笔记本电脑时要小心。

items.example: A careless mistake can cause trouble.
items.exampleZh: 一个粗心的错误会带来麻烦。

items.example: Do not use the computer carelessly.
I dropped some water on the desk.
items.exampleZh: 我把一些水洒在了桌上。

items.example: Leave it to dry before you use it.
items.exampleZh: 使用前先把它放着晾干。

items.example: Do not be worried about the test.

groups.sourceText: ask sb. to do / ask my mother to help me ...

items.example: I ask Dad to help me.

items.term: ask my mother to help me ...
items.example: I ask my mother to help me clean it.
items.exampleZh: 我请妈妈帮我把它清理干净。
